name: Long Sơn Pagoda
kicker: The seated white Buddha above the pagoda
summary: The white seated Buddha is the figure you come up to see. The provincial page prints 07:00–17:30 at 22 đường 23 tháng 10 and gives no ticket. Citing Báo Khánh Hòa, it prints 24 m from the ground, 21 m from the base, a 10 m lotus, and a 14 m statue. Vietnam Tourism prints 78 feet. Both height sets stay.
getThere: 22 đường 23 tháng 10. Minutes from the beach were not printed.
heroCaption: The seated white Buddha on the lotus pedestal
body: Long Sơn is also called the White Buddha Pagoda and Đăng Long tự on the provincial page. The address is 22 đường 23 tháng 10. Older records on that page say phường Phương Sơn. Newer administrative wording mentions phường Tây Nha Trang. Both ward names stay. Hours are 07:00–17:30. A ticket is not printed.

The statue figures on the provincial page, citing Báo Khánh Hòa, are 24 m from the ground, 21 m from the base, a lotus pedestal 10 m wide, and the statue itself 14 m. Vietnam Tourism prints a 78-foot Buddha. Those are different numbers, and both pages are left as printed. Minutes from Trần Phú were not printed.

gettingThere: The pagoda is at 22 đường 23 tháng 10. The provincial page does not print a ride time from the beach or the station.
